gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO MA AFTER EFFECTS - NEA ƐYƐ FOFORO
Version 9.2.9  -  October 2026
================================================================================

ANIME THEMES FOFORO 33 abɛka Demon Slayer de no ho, na themes no mouse effects no
pue ampa wɔ After Effects mu seesei, na Theme Pawbea no yɛ dropdown baako a ɛhyehyɛ yiye.

ANSA NA WOAHYƐ ASE
- Fa wo ZXP installer a wode di dwuma daa no sie version a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no so, afei
  hyɛ After Effects ase bio prɛko.
- Wɔbɛkora wo nhyehyɛe, theme, presets ne expressions a woakora no.

FOFORO: ANIME THEMES 33
- Flex Nhyehyɛe > THEME PAWBEA > PANEL THEME seesei wɔ kuw baako ma anime biara:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta),
  Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch),
  Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren,
  Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka),
  Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob),
  My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato),
  One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem),
  Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) ne Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Character biara wɔ ne ho nhwɛe: nea edi wo mouse akyi, ntohyɛ a ɛba bere a
  wopia button bi, nea esi bere a wokura benkum button no mu, ne
  ɔtopae a ɛba bere a woakura mu bɛyɛ seconds 2.5 akyi.
- Ɛyɛ hare te sɛ Demon Slayer themes no ara: effects no yɛ adwuma bere a wosɛn mouse no
  anaa wopia nko ara. Dum EFFECTS A ƐBƐN na kɔla ahorow no nko ara ntena hɔ.

NSAKRAEƐ: THEME PAWBEA
- Demon Slayer cards a na ɛwɔ PANEL THEME ase no nni hɔ bio, enti Flex Nhyehyɛe
  ayɛ tiaa. Paw theme biara fi PANEL THEME dropdown no mu; ebue wɔ
  theme a wode redi dwuma no so.
- Kurama ne Baryon wɔ Naruto kuw no mu seesei.

NSIESIE
- Themes no mouse effects (nsuo, ogya, anyinam ne nea aka) taa
  mpue wɔ After Effects mu, sɛ Optimised Mode adum mpo a. Bere a panel no ankasa
  reyɛ adwuma pii, ne mfiase a emu yɛ den, wɔfaa no sɛ theme no rekyɛ, enti
  effects no dum wɔn ho. Seesei, sɛ wo graphics card na ɛtwe wɔn a
  (kɔmputa dodow no ara), saa bere no ma effects no yɛ hare bere tiaa bi kɛkɛ.

NEA ANNSESA
- Licensing, activation ne link biara yɛ adwuma te sɛ nea na ɛte kane no.
- Demon Slayer themes 11 no te pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛ wɔ 9.2.8 mu no.
- Tab ne adwinnie foforo biara yɛ adwuma te sɛ 9.2.8 mu no.
================================================================================
